Our consolidated total revenues for the quarter stood at INR614 crores compared to INR635

digit growth in Q2 excluding the impact of this festive shift.

and the steady momentum of its core business. Coming to advertising revenue. Our 
consolidated advertising revenue stood at INR411 crores compared to INR439 crores in Q2 
FY26. 
 
While the timing of festive advertising impacted the year-on-year comparison, we remain

INR26 crores from INR24 crores in the corresponding period last year, reflecting an 
improvement in profitability.

remain focused on strengthening our digital presence through investments and content,

media brands.
